visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host with brown hair in a black jacket speaks directly to the camera in a dark studio. Behind him is a film clapperboard and a sign that says 'Democracy'. A large yellow text overlay appears at the top discussing Pizza Hut. (2) Rapid cuts show a series of bizarre pizza images: one with pig's blood cake and cilantro, followed by another topped with durian slices. (3) The host returns to the screen, speaking expressively with hand gestures. He is framed in a medium shot. (4) A segment from a TVBS news broadcast is shown, featuring a reporter talking about a new weird pizza flavor. (5) A montage of various promotional posters for unique Pizza Hut collaborations follows, including 'Attack on Titan', 'Cardcaptor Sakura', and a crust-only 'Zero Damage' pizza. (6) The host is back in the studio, and a screenshot of a 'Global Views Monthly' article is shown with statistics comparing Pizza Hut and Domino's store counts. (7) The final shot shows the host looking thoughtful while several yellow question marks float around him, with text posing questions about Pizza Hut's success.
